heap.sizeWhy: 6144 MiB by plans/m2.md D43 (optilux/budget.py) over M2.P06's records (m2-budget-full-1, m2-budget-overworld-1, m2-diag-alone-1, m2-diag-switches-1 and m2-diag-defaults-1): 6144 and 7168 MiB cap a launch at 20 reloads in all five (the pair alone: 6144 to 9216) and the smallest is kept; the heap after GC reaches 904-1,190 MiB at reload 20, far under 75 % of 6144 (4,608), so the GPU memory binds, not the heap; a bigger heap only commits more private bytes.
